aboutHeading: Shalux — Premium Stone Fabrication in Brooklyn
aboutSubheading: Crafted surfaces, built to your vision
aboutText: At Shalux, every surface is crafted to reflect your unique vision. Operating from our Brooklyn workshop in Melbourne's west, we specialise in premium stone fabrication and expert tiling. From selecting the perfect stone type to customising finishes and edge details, we work closely with you to ensure the final result matches your style and practical needs. We pride ourselves on unparalleled craftsmanship and a seamless experience from start to finish.
servicesText: We deliver premium stone fabrication and expert tiling across Melbourne. From benchtops to feature walls, our Brooklyn team ensures every detail is finished to the highest standard.

services.title: Stone Benchtops
services.desc: Custom-fabricated stone benchtops for kitchens and bathrooms, tailored to your exact specifications.

services.title: Bathroom Tiling
services.desc: Expert wall and floor tiling for bathrooms, delivered with precision and premium finishes.

services.title: Kitchen Tiling
services.desc: Stylish and durable tiling solutions for kitchens, including splashbacks and flooring.

services.title: Floor Tiling
services.desc: Seamless floor tiling across residential and commercial spaces, built to last.

services.title: Feature Walls
services.desc: Eye-catching stone and tile feature walls that elevate any room or entryway.

services.title: Custom Stone Fabrication
services.desc: Bespoke stone cutting and finishing for unique projects across Melbourne's premium homes.
